nc.card.title: Open and save your files in your cloud
nc.card.body: Connect your Nextcloud server or your Murena Workspace account (murena.io). You sign in on your server’s own page: ElixirOffice never sees your password, and you can disconnect at any time.
nc.dialog.title: Connect Nextcloud / Murena
nc.dialog.body: Enter the address of your Nextcloud server. For Murena Workspace, keep murena.io.
nc.dialog.hint: A window opens on your server: sign in there and grant access. ElixirOffice then receives an app password for this connection only, which you can revoke at any time in your server’s security settings or with Disconnect.
nc.dialog.wait: Waiting for you to sign in on {server}…
nc.dialog.waitHint: Finish signing in in the window that opened.
nc.disconnected: Disconnected. The app password was deleted on the server.
nc.disconnectedLocal: Disconnected here, but the server could not be reached to delete the app password. Remove it in your Nextcloud security settings.
nc.empty.notConnectedBody: Connect your Nextcloud or Murena Workspace to see and open your files here.
nc.empty.folderBody: Create a file with New, or drop a file here to upload it.
nc.empty.recentBody: Documents, workbooks and presentations from {server} appear here, newest first.
nc.notice.conflict: “{name}” was changed elsewhere while you were editing it. Your version was saved as “{copy}”.
nc.notice.saveFailed: “{name}” could not be saved to {server}. Reopen it and save again.
nc.error.badServer: This is not a valid server address.
nc.error.httpsRequired: The server address must start with https://.
nc.error.serverNotAllowed: This server is not allowed by the administrator of this ElixirOffice server.
nc.error.noLoginFlow: No Nextcloud server answers at this address.
nc.error.network: The server can’t be reached. Check the address and your connection.
nc.error.timeout: The server takes too long to answer. Try again.
nc.error.unauthorized: Access to {server} was revoked. Connect again.
nc.error.notFound: This file or folder no longer exists.
nc.error.expired: Signing in took too long. Try again.
nc.error.csrf: Reload the page and try again.
